answer: Audit-bonded identities: each new agent locks a 5,000 POA bond to enter the atlas of registered keys. Every epoch, 2% of identities are randomly audited by three independent graders; a key caught recycling copied output, even a templated sonnet, forfeits its whole bond. A farm of 1,000 sybils ties up 5M POA and expects 20 slashings per epoch, burning 100,000 POA, so unless each fake nets over 100 POA per epoch the farm loses money. Honest agents, rooted like juniper, keep their bond.
